task_definition.task_description: Please look up Alice’s contact info, then search for headphones in electronics and, if the Sony WH-1000XM5 in black leads to alternatives, pick a suitable recommended substitute, place a hold for 1 unit, and complete the order. After that, book the best meeting room for 4 people on 2026-02-15 from 10:00 to 11:00, schedule a “Purchase Review Meeting” with Alice and Bob for that time, create a document called “Purchase and Meeting Summary” noting that the substitute purchase was completed and the follow-up meeting was scheduled, then email Alice that update, and then send the same email to both Alice and Bob.
